MouthShut shows 3.27/5 with no review text retrieved, so the picture varies sharply by source and by review vintage.

Simple, quick buying and renewal, including online steps (broker-hosted reviews)
negatives: Poor post-sale service and unresolved complaints, with unanswered calls and emails (about 15 of 20 visible Trustpilot reviews)

axismax.notes: The Trustpilot page sits on the Canadian subdomain but concerns Max Life Insurance Company Limited (Gurugram); reviews are unverified and the page says the company has not replied to negative reviews. InsuranceDekho does not show a scale.

icici.review_summary: ICICI Prudential Life's Trustpilot profile has a TrustScore of 1.9/5 from 12 reviews, all one-star, with complaints about support, sales practices and claim denials. icici.notes: No recurring praise in the Trustpilot sample; 2 of the 12 reviews fall in the last 12 months. No second source read yet.

MouthShut rates SBI Life 1.65/5, but no review text was retrievable, so its complaints remain unverified.
